args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback verified as `rolled_out`.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, paging the on-call engineer, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so per policy a future redeploy of it would require change-manager approval.
